summary: Receives TCP/IP data from Leuze ROD4 laser scanners and outputs raw distance data or blob-tracking interaction channels.
key_concepts: Connects to Leuze ROD4 laser scanners over TCP/IP and receives scanner data while Active is on.
Raw Data mode outputs 529 samples of measured X/Y positions in meters.
Blob Tracking mode groups nearby measured points into blobs and assigns persistent IDs.
Area of Interest can be disabled, distance based, or bounding-box based for blob tracking.
Protocol and Input Coordinate must match the scanner setup utility; mismatches can produce random incorrect data.
The scanner can be paired with Blob Track CHOP after validating network, coordinate, and output-mode settings.

key_params.name: netaddress
key_params.note: IP address of the ROD4 scanner

key_params.name: rod4porotocol
key_params.note: Binary ROD4 or ROD4plus ASCII-Remote protocol

key_params.name: inputcoordinate
key_params.note: Polar or Cartesian coordinates for ASCII-Remote mode

key_params.name: outputmode
key_params.note: Raw Data or Blob Tracking mode

key_params.name: maxpointdistance
key_params.note: Maximum point distance within one blob

key_params.name: maxblobmovement
key_params.note: Maximum movement allowed when matching blobs

key_params.name: allowmovementoutside
key_params.note: Continue tracking blobs after they move outside the area of interest

key_params.name: boundingboxmask
key_params.note: Mask TOP for bounding-box area of interest

key_params.name: rotate
key_params.note: Rotate incoming coordinates around the z-axis

common_gotchas: Official docs list this operator as unavailable in Non-Commercial licenses.
The ROD4 protocol and input coordinate parameters must match device setup utility settings; mismatches may still output random incorrect data.
Object detection mode on some Leuze models is not supported.
Raw Data mode outputs 529 samples of measured points; Blob Tracking mode changes the channel semantics.
Bounding Box Mask TOP is stretched to fit and can make the CHOP very slow if it cooks every frame.
Network/firewall/IP setup must be validated before assuming scanner data is live.
